messages:
GENTLEMAN~CLIFFORD sent out
Pincurchin and Raichu!

An electric current ran across
the battlefield!

Garchomp’s Garchompite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Mega

Garchomp has Mega Evolved
into Mega Garchomp!

The opposing Raichu flinched
and couldn’t move!

It’s super effective on
the opposing Raichu!

The opposing Magearna’s Magearnite is
reacting to CL

The opposing Magearna has Mega
Evolved into Mega Mag

It doesn’t affect the
opposing Rotom…

The opposing Porygon-Z
avoided the attack!

It’s not very effective on
the opposing Rotom.
Flutter~Mane lost some of its HP!
Incineroar was damaged by the recoil!
